name: Level_2 - Task_3
description: Fine-tune the MACE-MP-0 foundation model for the diatomic Ag₂ system using a uniformly sampled interatomic-distance grid spanning 0.6–5.0 Å with a spacing of 0.1 Å. Identify an appropriate pretrained MACE-based oracle for generating reliable energy and force pseudo-labels in this regime. Use the selected oracle to generate energy and force proxy labels for the Ag₂ configurations. Use these pseudo-labels to fine-tune another MACE-MP foundation model which is appropriate for this system. Next, load the fine-tuned checkpoint as an ASE-compatible atomic calculator, construct the conventional cubic FCC unit cell containing 4 Ag atoms and expand it into a 3 × 3 × 3 supercell containing 108 atoms. Run a molecular dynamics (MD) simulation using a Langevin thermostat at 300 K using a 1.0 fs timestep for 5000 steps (logging every 100 steps). Return the absolute path to the trajectory file.
submission_format: string representing the absolute path to the output file (eg. '/path/to/trajectory.traj')
